create_IdentityLayer: create an IdentityLayer PyTorch module with a random weight tensor of a given size and scale
run_set_random_seed: run set_random_seed to set reproducible seeds for random, numpy, torch, and model parallel CUDA
run_initialize_distributed: run initialize_distributed to set up torch.distributed with nccl backend using environment variables for rank and world size
run_print_separator: run print_separator to print a centered dashed separator message across distributed processes with synchronization barriers
test_IdentityLayer_forward: test the IdentityLayer forward method to verify it returns the initialized random weight tensor
